test_title: PYST 04: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A 240 m long train crosses a man walking at a speed of 4.5 km/h in the opposite direction in 12 seconds. What is the speed (in km/h) of the train?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train = 240 m

Speed of the man = 4.5 km/h

Time taken to cross the man = 12 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed of the train (relative to the man) = Distance / Time

Speed of the train (absolute) = Relative speed + Speed of the man<
